title: Pig dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dancing pig: pink body, raised hoofs, curly tail, happy face -->
  <!-- ground shadow (lit soft) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- back legs (one kicked up behind) -->
  <rect x='58' y='72' width='10' height='14' rx='5' fill='#e07aa6'/>
  <rect x='30' y='76' width='10' height='10' rx='5' fill='#e07aa6'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='63' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#f59ac0'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#ffc2da'/>
  <!-- front arm raised up (dancing) -->
  <rect x='22' y='44' width='9' height='18' rx='4.5' fill='#ee8ab4' transform='rotate(-30 26 53)'/>
  <!-- other front arm up other side -->
  <rect x='66' y='42' width='9' height='18' rx='4.5' fill='#ee8ab4' transform='rotate(25 70 51)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='34' r='20' fill='#f59ac0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M34 18 Q30 6 42 12 Z' fill='#e07aa6'/>
  <path d='M62 18 Q66 6 54 12 Z' fill='#e07aa6'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='40' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#ffb0cf'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='1.8' fill='#c4557f'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='40' r='1.8' fill='#c4557f'/>
  <!-- eyes happy closed arcs -->
  <path d='M38 28 Q41 24 44 28' stroke='#7a2f4d' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 28 Q55 24 58 28' stroke='#7a2f4d' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 46 Q48 51 54 46' stroke='#7a2f4d' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- curly tail -->
  <path d='M72 60 q8 -2 6 -8 q-2 -5 -7 -2 q-4 3 1 5' stroke='#c4557f' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little blush -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='36' r='3' fill='#ff86b0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='36' r='3' fill='#ff86b0' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
